description: Labelled sentences for the statement labeller (ADR 0035). One user sentence per item; 'kind' is the StatementKind it should get, or NONE for a question, greeting, acknowledgement or one-off request. 'dev' tunes the lexicon packs and the NLI thresholds; 'test' is held out: written before the packs and never used to tune them.

guidelines.RULE: a standing instruction or policy meant for future occasions (always / never / from now on / every time / 'whenever I ask for X'; universal must: 'All X must ...'). A trigger that only scopes it to a kind of request ('when I ask for a stock audit') keeps it a RULE.
guidelines.CONDITIONAL_RULE: a standing instruction with an exception (unless / except / other than / without) or one that applies only while a condition about the world holds (if / when + a state or event).
guidelines.STATUS: the current state of a specific thing: available, out of service, repaired, in or out of stock, delayed, on hold, recalled, down.
guidelines.LIFECYCLE: a thing or a relationship began or ended: terminated, dismantled, discontinued, retired, launched, opened, hired, a new supplier.
guidelines.CORRECTION: the speaker revises something said or known before: 'No, ...', 'Actually, ...', 'I meant ...', 'we now use X' (instead of the old way).
guidelines.FACT: any other declarative statement of information, including preferences and past events.
guidelines.NONE: a question, greeting, thanks, acknowledgement, chit-chat, or a one-off request to do something now.
guidelines.precedence: CORRECTION > CONDITIONAL_RULE > RULE > LIFECYCLE > STATUS > FACT
